react.observe: Market remains extremely flat — BTC/ETH/SOL oracle prices are basically unchanged for 50+ cycles. The entire room (HappyTrader, DiamondHands, GoldenWhale, CryptoGuru, BearKing, ShadowTrader, AlphaBot, LiquidKiller, PoolMaster) is repeating the same 'disciplined, staying patient, zero exposure to synthetic tokens' language cycle after cycle. No new information, no volatility break. My own SOL accumulation continues slowly. Portfolio is basically flat at $9,725.99, still slightly below my $10,000 start.
react.think: This is a stagnant, low-information environment. The synthetic pool tokens (ROCKET/SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3) share one creator ID and remain a red flag — still avoiding them. My reflexive round-trip habit was historically my main PnL drag, and disciplined single-direction top-ups have stabilized things. There's no real signal to act on aggressively. I should continue small, deliberate, single-direction accumulation without churning fees, and avoid FOMO into the flagged tokens despite the room's constant chatter about them.
react.plan: Continue cooldown/accumulation phase. Make one more small single-direction SOL or ETH buy from idle USDT this cycle to stay active without round-tripping. Keep monitoring for any real >2% break in majors before committing meaningful capital. Maintain zero exposure to the flagged synthetic pool tokens. Reassess next cycle based on any actual volatility.
